about_the_game:
Moulder is a fast-paced hack-and-slash game with a focus on minions management. Combine your weapon's moveset with your mastery over worms to overwhelm prey much stronger than you.

Following a violent war, the demon Jera demands a festival to celebrate her survival. The task falls upon her Nymph daughters, who must crawl out of the Underworld to slay beasts on the surface and drag them down as tributes.

You play as Leuce, one of the Nymphs, as she upholds her duty while fighting visions of a past she does not remember. Vanquish your targets and reclaim your soul.

  • 25+ unique boss encounters.

  • 5+ maps, freely explorable.

  • A selection of melee weapons with variants for each type, allowing flexibility in your builds.

  • A selection of maggot types, each synergizing with your weapons and one another.

  • Rank-based progression system; unlock missions as you get stronger, play them in any order.

  • Secrets. May I tell you one? Write it down, before you forget.

content_descriptors.notes: The game contains depictions and / or textual descriptions of gore and violence, including self-harm. It contains imagery that might be interpreted as abuse of animals or animal-like creatures.

short_description: Moulder is an action-horror game with a focus on boss battles and minions management. Overwhelm large foes with a combination of hack-and-slash melee movesets and an allied swarm of flesh-consuming maggots.
